disks.description: The host's data filesystems (ext4, xfs, btrfs, zfs, …; one per device, without Docker's and Falak volumes' mounts), as df reports them: the control plane alerts per mount on used / (used + available) and forecasts when it fills. Omitted when none is readable.

missing_secrets.description: Site slugs whose env file (/run/falak/env) or container secret files (/run/falak/secrets) are gone, usually because a reboot emptied the tmpfs. The control plane answers with site.env.write. Sent with every heartbeat until restored; omitted when empty.

connections.description: Open client connections and the server's limit (falak-db stats, refreshed at most once a minute); healthy running instances only, omitted until known or when the image predates the command.

pitr.description: Instances with point-in-time recovery on: the spool's size (all of <volume>/spool), the volume's size, the unshipped segments and when the oldest was spooled (its age is the shipping lag), the last acknowledged upload and the last shipping error.

databases.description: Database containers on the server (label falak.db.instance), every heartbeat; omitted when there are none. secrets_missing: the instance's password file is gone (a reboot emptied /run/falak/secrets) and its container cannot start; the control plane answers with db.instance.secrets.

name.description: Container name, slice key (falak-<name>.slice) or program name

site.description: Site slug (label falak.site, or the program's site)

count.description: Kills or restarts since the previous event of the same service

service_events.description: OOM kills (docker `oom` events, slices' memory.events oom_kill) and restarts (containers' RestartCount, programs' restart counters) since the last delivered heartbeat; dropped by the agent once a heartbeat carrying them succeeded. Omitted when there are none.

facts.description: Only sent when changed since last heartbeat
